email.body1:
Shelby, saw Nitro ship Smart Redact, the Claude MCP connector, and Nitro Automate.

A wave of new product usually surfaces more in-market accounts than reps can act on quickly, and the lag between a signal firing and a rep touching it is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up the moment a signal hits, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Nitro off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Shelby, quick follow-up for Nitro.

With new automation products to sell, signal-to-action latency and data hygiene are usually what cap measurable pipeline lift, not effort or rep count. The real fixes are rarely visible until someone actually looks at the live motion end to end.

Worth 15 minutes? I'll walk you through a teardown of your current outbound, three specific things I'd change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.

Shelby, last bit of proof for Nitro.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Nitro's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
